outline.text: GrowthLoop is the agentic, composable CDP that drives compound growth by uniting your cloud data and AI into one Compound Marketing Engine.
AI-generated audience Omnichannel journey Real-time insights
The world’s leading enterprises trust GrowthLoop
Our agentic, composable CDP delivers rapidly accelerating growth
Replace engineering tickets and SQL once and for all with a visual, no-code, self-service audience-building interface built for marketers.
Drive more LTV by injecting intelligence across every channel by activating multi-step, batch, or real-time journeys right from GrowthLoop, your centralized agentic layer.
AI that finds your next revenue opportunity before you do
Grow smarter with every iteration as agentic AI learns from performance over time to deliver increasingly precise, revenue-driving insights.

Give your marketers agentic, growth-driving superpowers
When marketers have the power of agents at their fingertips, they’ll build their most powerful audiences, their most revenue-generating campaigns, and make data-driven improvement in seconds.
Use your own words, not SQL
Unleash your creativity, not your SQL skills. Simply describe your goals, audiences and campaign journey, and watch the magic of agentic AI constructing a revenue-generating campaign for your review.
Stay in control with full visibility and approvals. Agents follow your commands while making data-informed suggestions along the way.
Each agent is fueled by accurate, real-time data from your data cloud so audiences, journeys, and campaigns improve as insights are analyzed - a critical component to compound growth.
One platform to securely deploy and scale agentic AI across your enterprise
Turn your data into a compounding growth engine
By activating your most valuable data — and enriching it with campaign performance — you create a self-improving cycle where AI continuously refines and optimizes your marketing.
Secure by design from day one
Data never leaves your cloud, is never copied, and stays fully secure with built-in governance, PII protection, and privacy controls.
Get started in weeks, not months
Just say no to shelf-ware. Integrate your cloud, activate your channels, and get started launching powerful campaigns right away.
Connect natively to Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks and Redshift so your data warehouse becomes your activation engine.
Compound marketing starts in the cloud

Build and trigger personalized omnichannel campaigns
Journey Agent analyzes past performance and real-time engagement to proactively suggest and build personalized campaigns — then launches them across every channel, instantly.
